body:
~/.cargo/bin aside, ~/dl-zmx.el is the working human front-end that zmux generalises away from Emacs:
- naming: <project>-<id>, label-safe; labels project=P id=ID, both derived from the same pair so name and labels cannot disagree.
- launcher as data: `dl-zmx-launcher` defaults to systemd-run --user --scope --collect, nil disables it; the docstring states the cgroup reason precisely.
- parse: `zmx list` whitespace/tab fields into an alist, skipping `ended`, labels kept as ordinary fields, stderr discarded when there are no sessions, cwd unhexed from a file:// URL.
- switching: completing-read over running sessions, annotated with project, attached count and directory; buffer per session (term-<name>); display before spawn so the PTY gets the window size.
- tests assert argv and parsing, never systemd — the precedent c-devjail asks zmux to follow.
What it does not have: project-scoped creation from outside Emacs, a program surface, preview, or any view that is not Emacs buffers.
title: dl-zmx.el: the prior art, and what it proves
